approvalScope: Create repository files and publish sanitized code/documentation to bmkinney's existing public GitHub repository; Azure deployment requires separate approval.
authority: Single writer; manually fenced promotion and failback
replicationScope: Current secret state; no historical versions, keys, certificates, or automatic deletion/purge
vaultSelection: Independent new/existing same-subscription vaults; settings and existing topics preserved
vaultAuthorization: Vault access policies by default for solution-managed vaults; RBAC opt-in per side. Reused vaults preserve their detected authorization model, including mixed configurations.
previewability: Deterministic nested-module inputs; runner-generated read-only existing-vault/IAM metadata; preserve legacy assignment names; reject incomplete structured what-if coverage before any apply. Users edit parameters only.
destinationCollisions: Reject unmanaged names unless overwrite explicitly approved
networkException: Event Grid system identity uses trusted-service public endpoint delivery on the Microsoft backbone.
upstreamHandling: Unchanged, Git-excluded nested clone. Original implementation with attribution.
